description: Per-work public-domain status attestation. Core admission gate for the creative-pd substrate (films / video / music / audio). G1 STRUCTURAL: pdStatusByJurisdiction MUST cover ≥7 jurisdictions {USA, EUR, GBR, JPN, AUS, CAN, CHN}; per-jurisdiction status enum is REJECT if any is not 'public-domain' or 'creative-commons-zero'. G2 STRUCTURAL: pessimisticThresholdYearsPostMortem ≥70 (EU/UK/JP-post-2018/AU baseline). G3 STRUCTURAL: for modality enum {'music-recording', 'audio-speech', 'audio-sound', 'film', 'video'} both compositionPdStatus AND recordingPdStatus required; symbolic-only ('music-symbolic') sidesteps recording dual-attestation. G8 STRUCTURAL: attributionChainCid REQUIRED. NO blanket-PD assumption — every work attested individually before admission to e7m-dataset bucket.

workId.description: Globally unique work identifier; format = '{sourceArchive-id}:{work-numeric-or-slug-id}' (e.g. 'librivox:12345' or 'mutopia:0001-bach-bwv0001')

modality.description: G3 STRUCTURAL: dual-attestation required for music-recording / audio-speech / audio-sound / film / video; music-symbolic sidesteps recording layer

sourceArchive.description: Source archive identifier: librivox.org / mutopiaproject.org / archive.org / imslp.org / nhk-creative-library / wikimedia-commons / lc-american-folklife / etc.

sourceArchiveLicenseTemplate.description: Per-work license tag as published by source: 'CC0-1.0' / 'PD-old-100' / 'PD-USGov' / 'CC-BY-4.0' / 'CC-BY-SA-4.0' / 'CC-BY-2.1-JP' (NHK Creative Library only) / 'Public Domain' / 'Mutopia-PD'

pdStatusByJurisdiction.description: G1 STRUCTURAL: ≥7 jurisdictions covered {USA, EUR, GBR, JPN, AUS, CAN, CHN}

pessimisticThresholdYearsPostMortem.description: G2 STRUCTURAL: ≥70 (EU/UK/JP-post-2018/AU baseline); pessimistic across all 7 jurisdictions

compositionPdStatus.description: G3 STRUCTURAL: REQUIRED for music-recording modality

recordingPdStatus.description: G3 STRUCTURAL: REQUIRED for music-recording / audio-speech / audio-sound / film / video modalities (anything with sound or moving image)

performerRightPdStatus.description: G3 STRUCTURAL: REQUIRED for audio-speech / audio-sound / film / video modalities if work has identified performers

wellbecomingFramingScanCid.description: G7 STRUCTURAL: IPFS CID of wellbecomingFramingScan record (Charter Rider §2(d) per-work scan)

attributionChainCid.description: G8 STRUCTURAL: IPFS CID of attribution chain document linking source → author/composer/narrator/contributors

jurisdictionConflictResolutionCid.description: If pdStatusByJurisdiction shows any 'conflict-rejected' or 'uncertain-rejected' status: IPFS CID of jurisdictionConflictResolution record explaining the rejection grounds; if absent, no conflict detected

tierClassification.description: Tier-A for PD/CC0 baseline (publishable); Tier-B with attribution-chain or NC carve-out (G13 fleet-internal for NHK)

internalOnly.description: Tier-B NHK + future NC sources: true → G13 fleet-internal carve-out (NOT externally published)

status.description: G1+G2 STRUCTURAL: ALL 7 jurisdictions must show 'public-domain' or 'creative-commons-zero' for Tier-A admission; 'creative-commons-attribution' → Tier-B with attribution chain mandatory; any 'copyright-active' / 'uraa-restored' / 'uncertain-rejected' / 'conflict-rejected' in even one jurisdiction → REJECT pessimistic

legalBasisCid.description: IPFS CID of per-jurisdiction legal-basis document citing specific statute/case-law establishing PD status

composerDeathYear.description: Composer death year; required for life+N rules (pessimistic ≤1956 for 2026 at 70-yr threshold)

anonymousOrCorporate.description: If true: term is 70 yr from publication (US/EU/JP) instead of life+70

uraaRestorationStatus.description: US-specific URAA §104A check for foreign works

performerDeathYears.description: Latest performer death year drives the pessimistic threshold

volunteerCc0Declaration.description: true for LibriVox volunteers + similar CC0-donating performer pools
